source: Written for VPM to the upstream plugin's options and output. Emotion's tests are retained in scripts/emotion-conformance/upstream (repository commit 49229553967b6050c92d9602eb577bdc48167e91, tag @emotion/styled@11.14.1).
changes: Written for VPM: the visitors, the css, keyframes, injectGlobal, Global, css prop and styled transforms, labels, minification, static serialization, target class names and import maps.
Minifies with vstylis (stylis 4.4.0) instead of stylis 4.2.0, which dropped the space a comment separates two words with: border: 1px /* thin */ solid red became border:1pxsolid red.

Source maps are written by the plugin (one mapping, the JSON of source-map's SourceMapGenerator) and imports are added as @babel/helper-module-imports adds them; package roots are found without find-root. Dependencies: vemotion-hash, vemotion-serialize and vstylis (3), instead of @babel/helper-module-imports, @babel/runtime, babel-plugin-macros, convert-source-map, escape-string-regexp, find-root, source-map, stylis and three Emotion packages (11).
No macros export (VPM's Emotion packages have no macro entries).
Without a file name, target class names hash the code with the module name @emotion/babel-plugin, as the original does (it finds its own package), so class names stay the same.
CommonJS, which Babel 7 loads synchronously; it loads VPM's ES modules with require().
Bundled declarations of the plugin's options.

verification.upstreamTests: The plugin's own tests (130) pass with this plugin, except two pinned by name: a fixture importing the @emotion/react/macro entry, and a snapshot recording stylis 4.2.0's dropped space.
verification.endToEnd: The plugin compiles Emotion's *.test.js files in the runtime suite, with VPM's runtime packages: all pass under React 16 and 18.
